summary.text: Ocean Fitts is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Jordan Varnadore and independent Joseph Hoolihan.
Fitts describes himself as a public policy student and civic organizer in Manatee County.

paragraphs.text: Ocean Fitts attended Northeast High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his background is in public policy, civic education and local organizing in Manatee County.
Fitts said his campaign is focused on accountable, stable government, and listed insurance stability, affordability, education, infrastructure, water, growth and local control among his priorities.
He said that Tallahassee should not keep taking power away from cities, counties and schools.
